entries.note: Crossref abstract of Honigberg ASH 2007 (Blood 110:1592, 16 Nov 2007) has the quote verbatim; mouse probe occupancy before human dosing. Untested opener 2007; ibrutinib, oral, R/R stage_or_line correct.

Advani JCO quote verbatim (epub 2012-10-08). Pollyea ASH 2009 abstract (20 Nov 2009) reports 89% PBMC occupancy at 4 h: readout moved, same 2009. NCT00849654 has no posted results; registry_date null right. Ibrutinib oral.
Quote verbatim in Honigberg ASH 2007 abstract: probe occupancy stated as the dosing readout before the phase 1. Untested opener 2007; ibrutinib, oral, stage_or_line correct.

Advani abstract quote verbatim; full occupancy at 2.5 mg/kg first public epub 2012-10-08 (Pollyea 2009's 89% sat under the >90% target). Same 2012; margin_stated false right; registry_date null right; ibrutinib oral.
Pollyea ASH 2009 abstract (20 Nov 2009) has the canine NHL sentence verbatim, before MCL responses; PNAS 2010 (epub 2010-07-06) details dog responses. Untested opener 2009; ibrutinib oral correct.

NEJM quote verbatim (epub 2013-06-19); ASH 2011 abstract (18 Nov 2011) ORR 67% (16/24) seen. Single-arm, primary ORR, no pre-set bar, written in note: same 2011. Ibrutinib oral, R/R stage_or_line right.

Zhang 2017 CCR abstract quote verbatim (epub 2017-03-27); PDXs built from donors with known ibrutinib outcomes after MCL results, so retro 2017. Ibrutinib oral; mixed B-lymphoma donors coded unselected, acceptable.
Quote verbatim in bundled 205552 PharmR text. Tier 2; untested opener, proxy year 2009 at first-in-human; ibrutinib oral, stage_or_line correct.

Quote verbatim in bundled PharmR; review also states increased platelet counts in rats and dogs. 2013 label lists MCL platelet decreases 57% but no animal platelet data, so the comparison was first public with the 2014 review: contra 2014.

Sci Adv abstract quote verbatim (epub 2025-12-05). Readout in the acalabrutinib-alone lead-in of AVO, so combination_with null right; acalabrutinib oral, mixed-line MCL coded unselected; untested not_measured opener fits.

Same verbatim quote; four MCL patients' cycle-1 acalabrutinib monotherapy response compared after it was known: retro 2025. Acalabrutinib oral, combination_with null, unselected correct. Readout is WBC kinetics, not a trial endpoint (rule question stands).

Rahal Nat Med abstract quote verbatim (epub 2013-12-22). TRAF2/BIRC3-lesion insensitivity prediction for ibrutinib; biomarker_selected, oral; untested not_measured right, no genotype-response patient data then.

Freeman 2022 Leukemia abstract quote verbatim (epub 2022-08-13); BIRC3 effect reported for the whole RAY cohort, temsirolimus arm included, so prognostic, not a test of ibrutinib insensitivity: untested unsettled agreed. Ibrutinib oral biomarker_selected.
Quote verbatim in bundled 213217 MultidisciplineR. Zanubrutinib is a member; untested unpublished opener, proxy 2014 at first-in-human; zanubrutinib oral correct.

New quote near-verbatim (OCR spacing) in 213217 review; R/R MCL thrombocytopenia 33/118 (28%) vs raised dog platelets in the same review: contra 2019 holds. AF 2 (1.6%) in R/R MCL, rightly dropped. Zanubrutinib oral.
Quote verbatim in bundled 210259 MultidisciplineR. Acalabrutinib untested unpublished opener, proxy 2014 at first-in-human; acalabrutinib oral correct.

Telemetry quote verbatim in 210259 review. Contra rests on ACE-LY-004 bleeding and platelet decreases that tolerated-dose animals did not flag; quote shows the silence only. Acalabrutinib oral, 2017 right.

Harrington 2016 PLoS One abstract quote verbatim (epub 2016-07-19). Own acalabrutinib track, oral, untested opener 2016 correct. Dog run post-dates ibrutinib MCL responses, so retrodiction should be true; no status effect.

Lancet abstract quote verbatim (epub 2017-12-11); single-arm ACE-LY-004, primary ORR 81%, design in note. Dog result (2016) post-dates 2011 ibrutinib MCL responses: retro 2017 right. Acalabrutinib oral; registry 2018-10-19.
Quote verbatim in Pollyea ASH 2009 abstract; shows the canine system in use for ibrutinib in 2009, adequate for an untested opener. Ibrutinib oral correct.

Patient quote verbatim in Wang ASH 2011 abstract (18 Nov 2011, MCL-only). Dog claim (PNAS Jul 2010) post-dates ibrutinib's own phase 1 'extremely well tolerated' (ASH 2009): retro 2011 correct, same-drug basis.

Harrington 2016 tolerability quote verbatim; a passing tolerability claim is a scorable prediction; untested opener 2016. Post-dates acalabrutinib's own CLL tolerability (Dec 2015), so retrodiction should be true; no status effect.
Lancet abstract quote verbatim (epub 2017-12-11). Retro basis is acalabrutinib's own NEJM Dec 2015 CLL tolerability, as the dose/safety rule requires; retro 2017 correct; acalabrutinib oral.

missing: Ex-vivo primary MCL/CLL cell buoyant-mass change vs in-vivo BTK inhibitor sensitivity, patient-level, comparison stated (Science Advances 2025, doi:10.1126/sciadv.ady2963, PMID 41348872): 'changes in cell buoyant mass within primary patient specimens ex vivo correlate with sensitivity to Bruton's tyrosine kinase inhibitors in vivo in MCL'. New track (ex_vivo, patient-level).

MCL cell-line pharmacogenomic profiling (Rahal 2014 Nat Med, doi:10.1038/nm.3435, PMID 24362935): ibrutinib-insensitive lines carry alternative NF-kB (TRAF2/BIRC3) lesions, found in 15% of 165 patients; a patient-level prediction of primary ibrutinib resistance. Track at least as untested/unsettled, or scored if a later patient-outcome paper tests TRAF2/BIRC3 vs response.

Acalabrutinib and zanubrutinib (members) have their own FDA nonclinical reviews (NDA 210259, 2017; NDA 213217, 2019) not in the bundle: dog/rat tox vs patient AF, bleeding and cytopenias should be checked as further safety entries on a tox track.

Acalabrutinib canine B-NHL (Harrington 2016, doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0159607) and zanubrutinib occupancy (PBMC and lymph-node, Tam 2019 Blood) are in notes only; they would be member-drug entries on the existing canine and occupancy tracks, no status change.

Acalabrutinib rat/dog GLP toxicology and dog telemetry (NDA 210259 MultidisciplineR 2017, in bundle): 'acalabrutinib had no toxicologically-significant effects on cardiovascular function in a cardiovascular study in telemetered dogs', while label lists AF/flutter 3% and hemorrhage; would be a safety track parallel to the ibrutinib/zanubrutinib tox tracks (likely contra).

Acalabrutinib platelet-function models (light-transmission aggregometry and humanized VWF-HA1 mouse thrombus formation) predicted fewer platelet effects than ibrutinib (FDA NDA 210259 MultidisciplineR 2017, pharmacology section); compare ELEVATE-RR head-to-head bleeding/AF (Byrd 2021 JCO, doi:10.1200/JCO.21.01210, CLL, imported_from). A comparative-safety track not drafted.
rule_questions: registry_date when the trial registry has no results posted: the draft uses the first-posting date; rule 6 reads as results posting only, implying null. Which?

Safety year when the FDA review was signed 2013 (MCL approval Nov 2013, NDA 205552 Orig1) but the bundled copy sits in the 2014 Orig2 folder: does the year follow the earliest public posting of any copy of the review (possibly 2013 under Orig1)?
Is 'occupancy correlated with efficacy' in a mouse paper a model-stated dose target for the dose cell, or only an engagement prediction, given the brief bars targets the model never stated?
magnitude 'opposite' on a silence-contradicted harm where animals moved the lab value the other way (platelets rose): the brief defines 'opposite' for a predicted harm that never appeared.

Is a biomarker's pooled prognostic effect across a randomized trial's in-class and out-of-class arms (RAY: ibrutinib vs temsirolimus) admissible as a same for a model predicting in-class insensitivity, or untested?

Efficacy, patient-level models (efficacy 5): when a per-patient ex-vivo prediction is compared with per-patient sensitivity on a non-endpoint measure (cycle-1 WBC kinetics in AVO), does the primary-endpoint rule demote it to untested, or does a patient-level readout stand on its own?
